templates.title: Basic Ballet
templates.description: An introduction to ballet vocabulary at the barre and in the center: posture, turnout, pliés, tendus and simple across-the-floor combinations.
templates.prerequisiteNotes: No prior experience required.
templates.attireNotes: Form-fitting clothing; ballet slippers or socks. Hair secured away from the face.

templates.title: Basic Jazz
templates.description: Isolations, basic jazz walks, pas de bourrée, simple turns and a short combination.
templates.prerequisiteNotes: No prior experience required.
templates.attireNotes: Jazz shoes or sneakers; clothing you can move in.

templates.title: Basic Hip Hop
templates.description: Grooves, bounce and rock, foundational party steps and a beginner-paced combo.
templates.prerequisiteNotes: No prior experience required.
templates.attireNotes: Comfortable clothes you can move in; clean sneakers.

templates.title: Basic Tap
templates.description: Toe, heel, shuffle, flap and ball-change—building rhythm from scratch.
templates.prerequisiteNotes: No prior experience required.
templates.attireNotes: Tap shoes (loaners sometimes available—call ahead).

templates.title: Basic Ballet
templates.description: Slow-paced barre with detailed alignment cues, followed by simple center work.
templates.prerequisiteNotes: No prior experience required.
templates.attireNotes: Form-fitting clothing; ballet slippers or socks.

templates.title: Intro to Horton
templates.description: Flat backs, lateral T, fortifications and the foundational shapes of Horton modern technique.
templates.prerequisiteNotes: For students who have never taken a dance class.
templates.attireNotes: Form-fitting clothing; barefoot or socks.

templates.title: Absolute Beginner Ballet
templates.description: Barre fundamentals with plenty of repetition and individual corrections.
templates.prerequisiteNotes: Little to no prior experience.
templates.attireNotes: Form-fitting clothing; ballet slippers or socks.

templates.title: Basic House
templates.description: Jacking, the basic box, shuffles and loose footwork to house music.
templates.prerequisiteNotes: No prior experience required.
templates.attireNotes: Sneakers with smooth soles; loose clothing.

templates.title: Basic Hip Hop
templates.description: Hip hop foundations and grooves at a slower pace.
templates.prerequisiteNotes: No prior experience required.
templates.attireNotes: Comfortable clothes you can move in; clean sneakers.
